verdict.rationale: Marqeta has no llms.txt: the probe returned 404, and docs.md and the OpenAPI paths also 404. However, individual docs pages are served as markdown (e.g. /docs/core-api/cards.md, introduction.md, quick-start.md), and an agentic-AI developer guide documents an official MCP server, so agents can consume docs page by page. That partly delivers agent-oriented documentation. Missing for 10: an llms.txt index, a root docs.md or full-docs markdown bundle, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of agent consumption.
